rule: Contracts, grants and cooperative agreements from the departments of Health and Human Services (including NIH and CDC), Defense and Homeland Security, USAID and State, whose description names pandemic or biodefense work (pandemics, COVID-19, biological threats, anthrax, smallpox, medical countermeasures, or named products such as Paxlovid), leaving out routine diseases. Every award from HHS's preparedness office (ASPR, which runs BARDA) counts, except its chemical, radiological and nuclear work. Only for a hand-checked list of organisations on the map: university-based centres are left out because their awards go to the university. Awards made through contracting consortia (much of Operation Warp Speed, including Novavax's main COVID-19 award) are listed under the consortium and so are missing. Amounts are total obligations, including purchases such as vaccine doses.
